## Où j'en suis
The dashboard grid is built on react-grid-layout, behind the `dashboards_v2` flag. Widgets can be dragged and resized, and the layout is saved per user and per dashboard through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, with a localStorage fallback when the request fails. Container queries failed on iOS 15 Safari, so widget sizing now uses a ResizeObserver hook (`data-size`). `DashboardTile` was renamed `WidgetCard`, the Storybook build is fixed, and lint and typecheck pass. Draft PR #418 is open. Legacy v1 dashboards stay untouched behind the flag until January.

- [prochaine-étape] Priya's UX review of the grid on iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15.7) before the Zest demo on Tuesday 24th
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only, in the flags admin (config change, no code)
- [essai-raté] Container queries: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules silently, so the widgets never resized on Zest's iPads. Replaced by a ResizeObserver hook (source: t08, t09)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards available behind the flag until January; nothing is removed now (source: t15)
- [décision] Use ResizeObserver sizing and drop container queries entirely (source: t09)
- [décision] Open the PR as a draft for Priya's UX review (source: t17)
